signals.thesis: SpaceX reported earnings showing its revenue doubled, driven by a surge in its artificial-intelligence business, sending its shares higher in late trading. Alongside the results, CEO Elon Musk announced that SpaceX and Tesla have formed committees to study a potential merger, formalizing deal speculation that followed last week's joint Roadster unveiling.
signals.title: SpaceX revenue doubles on AI business and Musk forms Tesla merger committees

signals.thesis: Extending the Middle East supply shock, Iranian attacks in the Persian Gulf escalated to strike more ship engine rooms and cause severer damage, while Houthi missile and drone attacks prompted Saudi Arabia to postpone its flagship investor conference to 2027. The escalation briefly drove benchmark oil prices above $111 a barrel and U.S. crude past $105, before oil slipped and equities rebounded on hopes of U.S.-Iran diplomacy.
signals.title: Iranian engine-room strikes push oil past $111 before U.S.-Iran diplomacy hopes temper rally

signals.thesis: Following days of AI credit jitters that saw investors buy credit-default swaps to hedge AI exposure and neocloud stocks slide again as South Korean neocloud Elice Inc. plunged 30% in its trading debut, AI-related shares rallied in Tuesday after-hours trading. Strong preliminary sales results from server-maker Super Micro Computer Inc. brought relief to investors over the outlook for AI infrastructure spending.
signals.title: Super Micro preliminary sales spark after-hours AI rally after Korean IPO rout and CDS hedging

signals.thesis: September U.S. housing market data came in weaker than expected, with home sales, construction, and builder sentiment all declining more sharply than forecast.
signals.title: U.S. September housing data shows broader-than-expected freeze

signals.thesis: European natural gas prices climbed above €90 for the first time in nearly four years, heightening the risk of a renewed energy crunch as Europe enters the peak winter heating season.
signals.title: European natural gas prices top €90 for first time since 2022
